faq.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.a: Times are shown on each apartment page; self check-in is possible in several apartments.
The cancellation terms of each apartment are detailed on its page and repeated before payment.
In most apartments: it is listed in the amenities of each apartment.
By card, on a page secured by Stripe. The stay is paid in full when booking.
